file_stem: RWB E1 020 Allocation and assignment engine v1
title: Allocation and assignment engine v1
goal: Give every NEW case a queue and an owner by rule before 07:00, ending allocation by spreadsheet
why: Owners start the day with their cases ready. The first matching ALLOCATION row picks the queue; the queue's method picks an owner below the cap.
triggers: RW-TEAMMGR owns; gets a summary per team
ace_note: No direct ACE read. It runs after JOB-02, which is gated on the ACE batch; product, region and band are already on the case.

reads.note: NEW cases, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

stores: Outbox: CaseAllocated (EV-02), CaseAllocationFailed (EV-03); ACE notification (summary to team managers); job record
rules: BR1: the first matching row in row order wins; 'Any' matches all
BR4: all owners at cap -> the case goes to the overflow queue
BR5: no row matches -> exception queue RWB-EXC
BR8: at most one allocation per case per business date
risks: All owners at cap -> overflow queue (MSG-P3-011)
No rule row matches -> RWB-EXC + EV-03 (MSG-P3-012)
Decision log write fails -> that case rolls back (MSG-P3-013)
example: Case RW-2026-000201: MORTGAGE, region BKK, exposure band B2
Row ALLOC-014 (ALLOC-2026.11) -> queue MTG-BKK-CO (team MTG-BKK, ROUND_ROBIN, cap 150)
Overflow queue MTG-BKK-OVF if every member is at 150
